    int level[MAXN], work[MAXN];

    Dinic() {
        memset(adj, -1, sizeof adj);
        cnt = 0;
    }

        to[cnt] = v; cap[cnt] = c; nxt[cnt] = adj[u]; adj[u] = cnt++;
        to[cnt] = u; cap[cnt] = 0; nxt[cnt] = adj[v]; adj[v] = cnt++;
    }

    bool bfs(int source, int sink) {
        memset(level, -1, sizeof level);
        queue<int> q;
        level[source] = 0;
        q.push(source);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int e = adj[u]; e != -1; e = nxt[e]) {
                int v = to[e];
                if (cap[e] && level[v] == -1) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[sink] != -1;
    }

        if (u == sink) return flow;
        for (int &e = work[u]; e != -1; e = nxt[e]) {

                int pushed = dfs(v, sink, min(flow, cap[e]));

                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    int maxflow(int source, int sink) {
        int result = 0;
        while (bfs(source, sink)) {
            memcpy(work, adj, sizeof adj);
            while (true) {
                int pushed = dfs(source, sink, INF);
                if (!pushed) break;
                result += pushed;
            }
        }
        return result;

    }
    return 0;
}
